summary: Independent design review of the frozen TASK-0081 specification e60c722d4de75c35d670f540709ec4f33cd5e1e4099c52ea4729e4e741e51d41, native REVIEW/V0 classification input 3875105cbba20cfff763ea519e9f091eddaf525ac48881c43e95a70960c228ca, and unchanged subject 734cb108f6416a4bce04a4fcee879d586a1f2cbe.
